description.html: What are 123 Bottom Boxes?

123 Bottom boxes, also known as snap lock bottom boxes, are a type of folding carton designed to keep your products safe through their interlocking mechanism. This type of folding carton is popular among various products, including candles, snacks, baked items, and more, due to the protection it provides. The mechanism of this box style is famous for gable boxes and tuck-end boxes, which provide secure protection to your products without worrying about them falling out from the bottom.
Safe, Durable & Cost-Effective 123 Bottom Boxes

123 bottom boxes are built to handle products that require extra support during storage, shipping, and retail display. Their reinforced bottom construction provides greater strength than standard tuck bottom boxes, making them a reliable choice for packaging heavier or more delicate items.

These boxes are manufactured from durable paperboard and can be customized with different material thicknesses to match your product’s weight and packaging requirements. Despite their sturdy construction, they remain cost-effective to produce, offering an excellent balance between durability, functionality, and affordability. Whether used for food, cosmetics, candles, electronics, or other retail products, 123 bottom boxes provide dependable performance without increasing your packaging costs.

description.html: What are Auto Lock Bottom Boxes?

Auto lock bottom boxes, also known as crash lock bottom boxes or auto bottom cartons, are a type of folding carton featuring a pre-glued base that automatically locks into place when the box is opened. Unlike traditional tuck-end boxes, they require no manual bottom folding, glue, or tape during assembly, making packaging faster and more convenient. Their reinforced bottom structure provides dependable support for products such as candles, glass jars, cosmetics, food items, and retail goods. These boxes ship flat for easy storage and can be customized with branded printing, different sizes, and premium finishes to meet specific packaging needs.
Auto Lock Bottom: Fast & Reliable Packaging Solutions

Auto lock bottom boxes are an ideal choice for retail brands, offering both affordability and convenience. These boxes are also referred to as auto-lock bottom cartons that feature an automatic locking bottom. You can easily assemble them by gently squeezing them into a box with a closed bottom.

description.html: Provide Excellent Protection To Your Products By Using Cardboard Box Dividers

Cardboard packaging dividers, also known as box partitions, are designed to provide excellent protection while organizing products in an appealing way. They help in organizing multiple products at once, whether you want to showcase them on retail shelves or ship them.

These dividers use intersecting cardboard sheets to create separate compartments inside a box. They keep products organized, protected, and safely separated during handling and shipping. Custom boxes that use cardboard box dividers can hold multiple products without them colliding or shifting.
Why Use Cardboard Box Dividers?

Cardboard box dividers are ideal for organization and product protection. They can be customized in various sizes and shapes to fit a range of products. They work especially well for small items like toys, RC cars, cosmetics, bottles, and accessories. A snug fit also reduces movement and helps prevent scratches, dents, and other damage.

Besides protection, custom dividers can also improve the unboxing experience. Each product stays neatly placed in its own compartment. This creates a clean and professional presentation that customers can appreciate.

From precise die-cutting to quality printing, manufacturing these custom box inserts requires experience and accuracy. We have all the expertise to create custom dividers that fit your products perfectly and provide reliable protection.

How Ventilation Helps Burger Packaging
Hot burgers release steam after packing. If too much steam remains trapped, condensation can form inside the box and soften the bun.
Vent holes help excess moisture vapor escape.
However, more ventilation is not always better. Too many openings can allow heat to escape faster.

This is why ventilation should be designed around the burger instead of adding random holes to the packaging.
Grease, Moisture, and Structural Protection
Different packaging features solve different problems.
A grease-resistant coating does not replace ventilation, and ventilation does not replace structural strength. The box should be configured according to the food being packed.

description.html: Custom Cube Boxes Made to Fit Your Product

Custom cube boxes are packaging containers designed with equal or nearly equal length, width, and height. Their balanced shape provides multiple printable panels for branding while creating a compact structure for product protection, retail display, gifting, storage, and shipping.

At Pack Legacy, every cube box is manufactured according to your product dimensions, weight, material requirements, preferred opening style, and artwork. You can order small cube boxes for cosmetics and favors, medium-sized packaging for candles and jars, or larger reinforced boxes for mugs, gift sets, and fragile products.

We supply the packaging empty and manufacture it around the product you intend to pack. Share your product dimensions, quantity, weight, and presentation requirements so our packaging team can recommend the correct internal size, stock thickness, closure style, and insert.
How to Measure Your Product for a Cube Box

Correct measurements are essential for creating packaging that holds the product securely without wasting material or leaving excessive empty space. Measure the product at its widest and tallest points before requesting a quote.

items: Measure the product’s maximum length from one outer edge to the other.
Measure its maximum width, including handles, lids, pumps, or protruding parts.
Measure the complete height from the base to the highest point.
Include extra space required for wrapping, cushioning, inserts, or accessories.
Confirm whether you are providing product dimensions or required internal box dimensions.

description.html: A product does not need to be perfectly cubical to fit inside a cube-shaped package. When the item is narrower or shorter than the internal space, a custom insert, platform, or divider can hold it in the correct position.

description.html: Choose the Right Cube Box Style

The appropriate structure depends on the product’s weight, how customers will open the packaging, whether it will be displayed on a shelf, and the level of protection required. We can customize the opening, bottom closure, lid, window, and internal support according to your application.
Straight and Reverse Tuck Cube Boxes
Tuck-end cube boxes are lightweight folding cartons with top and bottom flaps. They are suitable for cosmetics, soap, small candles, accessories, favors, and other lightweight retail products.
A reverse tuck end box has closing flaps that fold in opposite directions, providing straightforward assembly and convenient product access.
Auto-Lock and 1-2-3 Bottom Cube Boxes

Products such as candle jars, bottled goods, mugs, and heavier retail items may require a stronger bottom closure. Auto-lock and snap-lock structures provide more base support than basic tuck-end cartons.
Our 1-2-3 bottom boxes use interlocking bottom panels that fold into a secure base. This style is suitable when additional bottom strength is required without using a fully rigid structure.
Two-Piece Cube Boxes
Two-piece cube boxes include a separate lid and base. They create a clean, premium presentation for gifts, candles, ornaments, jewelry, accessories, keepsakes, and product sets.
For a more substantial structure, consider two-piece rigid boxes made with thick greyboard and wrapped paper. These boxes are suitable for luxury products and reusable gift packaging.
Rigid Cube Boxes
Rigid cube boxes provide greater thickness and a premium hand feel. They can be manufactured with removable lids, magnetic closures, shoulder-and-neck structures, or collapsible designs.
They are ideal for high-end gifts, executive products, ornaments, luxury candles, cosmetics, accessories, and promotional kits where presentation is as important as product protection.
Cube Boxes With Windows
A die-cut window allows customers to see the product without fully opening the packaging. Windows can be placed on the front, top, corner, or multiple panels depending on the product design.

Choose an open cutout or add transparent window patching when the product needs a protective covering. Explore our custom die-cut boxes for additional cutout, window, and structural customization options.
Cube Boxes With Handles

Built-in handles can make lightweight gifts, bakery items, event favors, and promotional products easier to carry. The handle style and material strength should always be selected according to the filled weight of the box.
Materials for Custom Cube Packaging

The material determines the box’s strength, print quality, appearance, flexibility, and suitability for retail or shipping. Explore our complete packaging materials and finishes to compare available paper stocks, coatings, laminations, and specialty options.
Paperboard and Cardstock

Paperboard is a lightweight and highly printable material suitable for cosmetics, skincare products, soap, candles, small gifts, confectionery, and retail accessories. It supports detailed artwork, small typography, product information, and vibrant color printing.
White Cardboard

White cardboard provides a clean printing surface for full-color branding. It is appropriate for retail cube packaging requiring sharp graphics, accurate product information, and a professional shelf-ready appearance.
Kraft Paperboard

Kraft material creates a natural and minimalist appearance. It is commonly selected for handmade products, organic-style branding, candles, soap, favors, confectionery, and eco-conscious product presentation.
Our custom kraft boxes can be personalized with logos, line artwork, patterns, product information, and contrasting ink colors.
Corrugated Board

Corrugated cube boxes provide additional strength and cushioning for heavier, fragile, or shippable products. They are suitable for mugs, glass jars, product sets, subscription items, ecommerce orders, and products requiring extra structural support.
The appropriate flute and wall construction should be selected according to the product weight, dimensions, shipping method, and insert requirements.
Rigid Greyboard

Rigid greyboard is designed for premium presentation packaging. Its thicker structure is appropriate for luxury gifts, ornaments, candles, cosmetics, keepsakes, accessories, and high-value promotional products.
Paperboard and cardboard options are available in different thicknesses, while rigid structures can be manufactured with thicker greyboard according to the required size and strength.
Custom Inserts for Secure Product Placement

An insert holds the product in a fixed position and reduces unnecessary movement inside the packaging. It can also improve presentation by centering the item and creating organized compartments for multiple products.
Available insert options include:

Paperboard inserts are suitable for lighter retail items, while corrugated inserts provide more support for mugs, glass jars, and heavier products. Foam inserts may be used for fragile, high-value, or presentation-focused items.

The insert should be designed around the complete product dimensions rather than the box dimensions alone. Provide a physical sample, technical drawing, or accurate measurements when a precise fit is required.
Products Commonly Packed in Cube Boxes
Candles and Wax Products
Cube packaging is commonly used for jar candles, votives, wax melts, and candle gift sets. A fitted insert or reinforced bottom can support glass containers and prevent movement during handling.
Businesses selling scented, decorative, or luxury candles can also explore our custom candle boxes for additional structures and presentation options.
Cosmetics and Skincare Products

Cosmetic jars, creams, body butter, bath products, soaps, and skincare sets can be packed in compact cube cartons with product information, ingredients, usage instructions, barcodes, and brand artwork.
Our custom cream boxes provide additional packaging options for cosmetic jars and skincare products requiring a secure retail presentation.
Gifts, Favors, and Ornaments

Cube gift boxes can be customized for wedding favors, event gifts, keepsakes, jewelry, souvenirs, holiday decorations, and promotional items. Ribbons, foil stamping, inserts, and two-piece structures can create a more refined presentation.
Fragile decorative items can also be packed in custom ornament boxes with dividers or protective inserts.
Confectionery and Bakery Products

Cube-shaped cartons can be used for chocolates, candy, truffles, cookies, small cakes, and edible favors. The material, coating, barrier, and inner wrapping must be selected according to the food product and direct-contact requirements.
Mugs, Glassware, and Fragile Items

Mugs and glass products often require corrugated cube boxes with fitted inserts or partitions. The box should be sized around the product’s widest point, including handles, lids, and decorative parts.
Retail and Promotional Products

Small electronics, accessories, toys, promotional items, collectibles, and product bundles can be presented in custom printed cube boxes with hang tabs, windows, QR codes, inserts, or shelf-ready branding.
Print Your Branding on Every Panel

The balanced shape of cube packaging provides several panels for branding, product information, instructions, and promotional content. Printing can be applied to the exterior, interior, or both sides of the packaging.
You can add:

We support CMYK printing for full-color artwork and Pantone color matching for projects requiring specific brand colors. Customers may select outside printing, inside printing, printing on both sides, or plain packaging without artwork.

description.html: Structural Add-Ons

Choose finishes according to the product’s positioning and expected handling. A matte surface with spot UV can create subtle contrast, while foil stamping and embossing are better suited to premium gift or luxury retail packaging.
Cube Boxes for Retail, Gifting, and Shipping
Retail Cube Boxes
Retail cube packaging is normally manufactured from printed paperboard or cardboard. It can include product details, branding, windows, hang tabs, barcodes, and shelf-ready graphics.
Gift Cube Boxes
Gift packaging may use two-piece or rigid structures with decorative paper, ribbons, inserts, foil stamping, embossing, or inside printing. These options create a more memorable opening experience.
Shipping Cube Boxes

Products intended for courier or ecommerce delivery may require corrugated board, secure closures, protective inserts, and additional cushioning. A lightweight folding carton should not be treated as a shipping box unless it has been designed for that purpose.
Display-Ready Cube Packaging
Display-ready cube boxes can include windows, cutouts, hang tabs, stackable panels, or bold printed surfaces that help products stand out on retail shelves and counters.
Eco-Conscious Cube Packaging Options

Customers seeking to reduce unnecessary packaging can select right-sized paper-based boxes, kraft stocks, recyclable paperboard options, reduced-plastic window designs, and structures that use only the material needed for a secure product fit.

Reusable rigid cube boxes may also extend the useful life of premium packaging. Material certifications, recycled content, food-contact suitability, compostability, or other environmental properties should be requested and verified for the selected stock before production.
What Determines the Price of Custom Cube Boxes?

The cost of custom cube boxes depends on the complete specifications rather than the shape alone. Two boxes with identical dimensions may have different prices because of their materials, structure, printing, inserts, and finishes.
Pricing factors include:
Larger quantities generally provide a lower per-unit cost, while rigid construction, specialty papers, inserts, and premium finishes may increase the total price.
Review Your Dieline, Proof, and Sample
A dieline shows the cutting, folding, bleed, safe, window, and glue areas of your cube packaging. Request one of our free dieline templates to prepare your artwork correctly.

For the best printing result, provide vector artwork in AI, PDF, or EPS format whenever possible. Use CMYK or specified Pantone colors, outline fonts, embed linked images, and extend background artwork into the required bleed area.

Our design team will provide a 2D digital proof or 3D mockup before production. Review the dimensions, text, artwork placement, colors, folds, windows, barcodes, and QR codes carefully before approval.
You can also request one of our custom packaging samples when you need to inspect the structure, material, dimensions, printing, insert, or finish before placing a complete production order.

Pack Legacy manufactures custom cube boxes in the dimensions, structure, material, printing, and quantity your product requires. Choose lightweight folding cartons, reinforced corrugated packaging, premium rigid boxes, windows, handles, dividers, and fitted inserts.

We offer no minimum order quantity, free design support, digital proofing, wholesale pricing, fast turnaround, and free shipping. Order a small quantity for a new product launch or request volume pricing for a larger packaging requirement.

faqs.q: What is a custom dispenser box?
faqs.a: A custom dispenser box is a packaging format that holds multiple products and dispenses them one or a few at a time through a controlled opening. It uses features like perforated flaps or gravity-feed channels to keep products organized, secure, and easy to access at retail.

faqs.q: What products work best in dispenser boxes?
faqs.a: Products that work best in dispenser boxes are small, uniform items sold in multiples, such as candy, lip balm, sachets, supplements, pre-rolls, tea bags, gum, and wipes. These products benefit from controlled, one-at-a-time dispensing at POS locations.

faqs.q: How does a dispenser box work?
faqs.a: A dispenser box works by creating a controlled opening through a perforated flap, front panel, or dispensing slot. In gravity-feed designs, an internal angled channel moves products forward automatically, providing consistent access while keeping remaining items aligned inside the box.

faqs.q: What materials are used in dispenser boxes?
faqs.a: Dispenser boxes are made from materials such as 12pt–24pt SBS cardstock, corrugated board (E/B/C flute), and kraft paper. These materials are selected based on product weight, durability, and retail handling requirements.

faqs.q: What is the difference between a dispenser box and a display box?
faqs.a: The difference between a dispenser box and a display box is that a dispenser box controls product release through a defined opening, while a display box has an open front for direct access. Dispenser boxes improve organization and reduce over-handling of products.

faqs.q: Are dispenser boxes eco-friendly?
faqs.a: Dispenser boxes can be eco-friendly when made from recycled kraft board or corrugated materials and printed with soy-based inks. The level of sustainability depends on the material and finish options you select during production.

faqs.q: What is a gravity dispenser box?
faqs.a: A gravity dispenser box is a packaging design with an angled internal channel that moves products forward as each unit is removed. This keeps the front row consistently filled and is ideal for uniform products like bars, bottles, or cylindrical items.

faqs.q: What is the MOQ and turnaround for dispenser boxes?
faqs.a: We have no MOQ policy which gives you the liberty to choose according to your need and requirement. Our turnaround for dispenser boxes depend on size, material, printing method, and order quantity, mostly it takes 8-12 days. You can further confirm yours with Pack Legacy’s customer support team.

faqs.q: What is a perforated dispenser box?
faqs.a: A perforated dispenser box is a box with a die-cut perforation line on the front panel that can be torn to create a dispensing opening. It turns a closed box into a display box without tools.

Magnetic closure rigid boxes are specialized rigid packaging containers made from durable chipboard and designed with embedded magnets that allow the lid to close securely and smoothly. They offer an easy opening and closing experience with a gentle lift, making them ideal for premium product presentation.

Magnetic closure boxes are the perfect box style for showcasing and protecting luxury products in an appealing manner. No doubt, these boxes have become a popular choice among luxury brands for packaging their products due to their various benefits.

items: Durability: Their sturdy construction protects your product and keeps it safe in every retail environment.
Premiumness: They offer a premium look to your product while showcasing it effectively

What Material Options & Board Thickness Do Magnetic Closure Boxes Use?
Custom Magnetic boxes are made from durable rigid stock, which consists of two different materials: the base material and the printing material.
Base Material Options
The base material is the most important, as it helps create a durable structure for your custom magnetic rigid boxes.
Here are the base material options for magnetic rigid boxes:

items: Grey Chipboard: Thick grey board from recycled pulp, known for its solid structure and sturdy base.
Duplex Chipboard: Two-layer board featuring a smooth coated side and a sturdy uncoated back.
Thick Cardboard: Heavy-duty board material for extra strength & protection for packaging products.

description.html: The thickness of these materials ranges from 800 gms to 2000 gsm, depending on the product you want to store in them.
Printing Material Options
The printing material, also referred to as the exterior covering for these boxes, wraps around them to support high-quality printing and colors.
Here are the printing material options for magnetic closure boxes:

items: SBS C1S & C2S: High-quality paperboard with one or two coated sides for smooth printing.
Natural Kraft: Durable Kraft paper, available in brown, black, and white with a natural texture.
Holographic: Shiny holographic wrap that creates eye-catching, reflective effects.

description.html: Custom Retail Displays Designed for Stronger Product Presentation

Our custom pop-up display boxes present multiple products in a compact, branded format for retail counters, checkout areas, and shelves. The raised header provides prominent space for your logo and promotional message, while the open structure keeps products visible, organized, and easy for customers to access.

Each display is manufactured according to your product dimensions, required capacity, packed weight, and available retail space. Custom printing, dividers, packaging inserts, reinforced materials, and premium finishes can be added to create a display that supports both your merchandising requirements and brand identity.
Customized Around Your Product, Not a Standard Template

Your product determines the display. We develop the dimensions, board strength, header height, opening style, and internal arrangement after considering the size of each item, the number of units required, the total packed weight, and the available counter or shelf space.

Lightweight products such as lip balms, tea sachets, candy, cosmetics, and small accessories can be presented in sleek paperboard displays with sharp printing and a polished finish. Heavier products such as cream jars, supplement bottles, balms, and packaged food items require reinforced paperboard or corrugated construction for improved stability.

The internal layout is also customized to match your products. Dividers, partitions, and fitted inserts keep your items organized and protected, while tiered layouts improve visibility across the display. The result is a stable, organized retail display that presents products professionally and makes efficient use of counter or shelf space.
Choose the Display Structure That Fits Your Sales Strategy

Different products require different display structures. The right design depends on product size, weight, quantity, retail placement, and how customers interact with the display. We manufacture custom pop-up display boxes in a wide range to suit different product requirements.
Pop-Up Header Counter Displays

Featuring a raised rear header above the product tray, these displays provide prominent space for branding while keeping product visible and easy to access. They are widely used for lightweight products.
PDQ Boxes

Product Display Quickly boxes combine shipping and retail presentation in one unit. They allow products to be placed on shelves with minimal setup. They are commonly used for fast-moving consumer goods and promotional campaigns.
Pop-Up Displays with Dividers

These displays include custom dividers or partitions that keep products upright, separated, and securely positioned during transport and retail display. They are well suited for bottles, jars, and products offered in many sizes, flavors, or variants.
Tiered Product Displays

Tiered displays feature stepped rows that raise products placed at the back. This improves visibility of all products. This structure works well for cosmetics, skincare products, collectibles, electronic accessories, and product ranges where every variant should remain visible.
Display Perforated Boxes

Display perforated boxes work as both a shipping carton and a retail display. Once the perforated panel is removed, the carton converts into a ready-to-use merchandising unit. This makes it ideal for supermarkets, convenience stores, club stores, and promotional retail displays.
Front Cut-Out Display Boxes

These front cut-out display boxes have a lowered front panel that provides a clear view of the products while allowing customers to remove them easily. They are commonly used for confectionery, personal care products, stationery, packaged snacks, and other retail items that need continuous visibility and convenient access.
Material Options for Strength and Presentation
We offer premium materials that directly impact appearance, print quality, and product support.

SBS paperboard offers a smooth white surface that reproduces detailed graphics and vibrant brand colors with precision. It is an excellent choice for lightweight retail products and premium consumer packaging.

Corrugated board provides additional rigidity for heavier items, larger product quantities, and displays that must withstand transportation or extended retail use. E-flute construction provides strength while maintaining a refined printed appearance.
Kraft paperboard creates a natural, tactile look that complements organic, handmade, wellness, food, and environmentally conscious brands.
Select the right stock and thickness according to your product weight, display, dimensions, and required performance.
Custom Printing and Finishing For Stronger Brand Impact

Pop-up displays place your branding where buying decisions are made. They give you valuable space to capture attention at the point of sale. Every display can be printed with custom colors, logos, product graphics, barcodes, instructions, social media details, and QR codes. Custom-shaped header and die-cut design elements can also be incorporated, where the structure allows, to create a more distinctive appearance.

To complete the presentation, choose from matte, gloss, or soft-touch lamination, along with the premium enhancements such as spot UV, foil stamping, embossing, and debossing to highlight logos, product names, or key design elements. We recommend each finish that complements your artwork, strengthens shelf appeal, and creates a polished, professional display.
Easy to Assemble, Restock, and Adapt for Retail

Custom pop-up display boxes are designed to simplify retail merchandising from storage to restocking. They can be supplied flat to reduce storage space and assembled quickly through a simple folding and locking process. Depending on the approved design, the structure may include pre-gued panels, locking tabs, an automatic base, fitted partitions, or perforated sections for faster setup.

These displays are adapted to a wide range of retail categories, from cosmetics and skincare to wellness, confectionery, and other lightweight products. Their compact countertop design places products within easy reach, helping attract customer attention and encourage impulse purchases. Retail staff can restock products quickly without special tools or premium fixtures, keeping displays organized.

description.html: What are Shelf Ready Packaging Boxes?

Have a look at the core difference at a glance.

Designed to function as both shipping containers and retail displays. They travel through the supply chain as a sturdy, sealed shipping box. Once at the store, retail staff easily tear off a perforated section or lid and place the entire box directly onto the standard store shelf.

Designed primarily for visual marketing and quick consumer access. They are often set up on countertops display, as POP displays, or as endcaps. They are built to maximize impulse buys and visual impact, often requiring separate outer packaging during transit.
